rca of the issue: Original bug: requesters couldn't see any approval tracking on submitted Leave/Reimbursement rows in the Staff App — only a 'SUBMITTED' status badge appeared with no Track button or Pending-with info. Root cause: (1) Backend /api/leaves/my and /api/reimbursements/my did NOT run _attach_chain_to_request on read, so any request submitted BEFORE the center had an approval-chain configured had chain_snapshot=[] permanently. (2) Frontend LeaveTab/ReimburseTab gated the Track button on `current_level>0 && chain_snapshot.length>0` which meant items without a snapshot never rendered ANY tracking UI (not even a fallback). Fix (implemented by main agent, verified here): backend lazy _attach_chain_to_request migration writes chain_snapshot back to Mongo on first /my read; frontend switched to `hasChain = chain_snapshot.length>0 || chain_history.length>0` and added italic fallback 'Awaiting approval — no chain configured yet' for the truly-no-chain case, so the requester now ALWAYS sees a tracking element. Verified: 8/8 backend tests pass; Leave, Claim, and Regularisation tabs all show Track approval → button + modal with L1—L4 chain steps; Pending Approvals regression works.
